reviews.comment:
El viernes 17 de abril me acerqué a calibrar la rueda del auto casualmente un señor acompañado de su grupo familiar en su vehículo particular le consultaba al Playero si podía usar la fosa porque sentía un ruido en el tren delantero y necesitaba seguir viaje con muchísima vergüenza vi y escuché como este playero Por poco maltrataba al Señor que muy amablemente le pedía su ayuda. Excusándose que él era empleado del automóvil Club y no de la ypf. Ante la vergüenza ajena No tuve más remedio que entrometerme en la conversación y pedirle 1000 disculpas al Señor en nombre de Los Alteños porque este Playero no nos representa para nada carente de empatía simpatía buena voluntad caballerosidad educación y solidaridad características que son propias del salteño le pedí disculpas al Señor en nombre de todos los Alteños y con mis pocos conocimiento trate de indicarle A dónde se podría acercar para solucionar su problema mecánico y así poder proseguir con el viaje. El cuanto al Playero zoloto por esconderse en su cabina y no dar ninguna explicación es ante el reclamo que el efecto es por la mala atención a un cliente o en este caso a una persona mayor y turista a la vez una vergüenza total.

(Translated by Google)
On Friday, April 17th, I went to get my car's tires checked. A gentleman with his family in his car happened to be asking the gas station attendant if he could use the pit because he heard a noise in the front suspension and needed to continue his journey. I was incredibly embarrassed to see and hear this attendant almost mistreat the gentleman, who was very politely asking for help. He excused himself by saying he was an employee of the Automobile Club, not YPF. Feeling ashamed for him, I had no choice but to intervene and apologize profusely to the gentleman on behalf of the people of El Alto. This gas station attendant doesn't represent us at all; he lacks empathy, friendliness, courtesy, and solidarity—characteristics that are typical of the people of El Alto. I apologized to the gentleman on behalf of all the residents of El Alto and, with my limited knowledge, tried to direct him to a service station where he could get his mechanical problem fixed so he could continue his trip. As for the beach attendant Zoloto hiding in his booth and not giving any explanation, the effect of the complaint is due to the poor service to a customer, or in this case to an elderly person who is also a tourist; it is a total disgrace.
